footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss: includes a $51.7M income tax benefit; after $5.6M of losses from equity method investments.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 83.4% to $1.3B in 2025. Gross margin was 62.7%, versus 55.0% a year earlier, and the operating loss narrowed to $253M from $691M.
The net loss narrowed to $245M, or −$1.41 per share, from $706M. Operating cash flow was −$218M and free cash flow −$239M, versus −$211M.
sources: Tempus AI, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

risks: We have incurred significant losses since inception, we may continue to incur losses in the future…
Our current or future products may not achieve or maintain sufficient commercial market acceptance
Our operating results may fluctuate significantly, which makes our future operating results difficult to predict…
The success of our business depends on our continued access to, and ability to monetize, de-identified patient data
Our limited operating history and rapid growth make it difficult to evaluate our future prospects and the risks and challenges we may encounter
We may need to raise additional capital to fund our existing operations, develop our Platform, commercialize new products or expand our operations
